notes: Six pages, seven snapshots read (all Common Crawl captures; only the files listed in chunk-51.json were read). (1) Kellogg MORS alumni page: year headings "YYYY Graduates" recorded as graduation years; the placement after the dissertation year is the employer as written (nav labels the program "PhD Program in Management & Organizations"). (2) Kellogg MORS "PhD Candidates on the Job Market": no year printed, so listedYear is null and yearMeaning "job-market"; the snapshot date (2015-09-04 / 2016-09-30) indicates the job-market season; adviser names kept in note, e-mail addresses omitted. (3) Kellogg Doctoral Program Job Placement page: "Recent job placements ... 2005 - 2016" organised by department and year, so yearMeaning is "placement" (not graduation); department headings used as program; postdoctoral and other explicit titles split into position with the original wording kept in note; name annotations such as "(Economics PhD student with Finance advisors)", "(JD-PhD)" and "(Economics)" moved to note; Mustafa Akan and Xiaoyuan Lauren Lu are listed twice (Managerial Economics and Strategy and asterisked under Operations Management) and both rows are kept; Robert Dam appears under Finance 2012 (US Air Force Academy) and 2015 (University of Colorado, Boulder), both rows kept as written; "No students on the job market" entries produced no records. The same people appear on the MORS alumni page and the Job Placement page with slightly different name spellings (e.g. Wohlegezogen/Wohlgezogen, Juinwen/Jiunwen Wang, Tae Hyun/Tae-Hyun Kim) and destinations; rows kept per page as written. (4)(5) Purdue Krannert "Alumni Achievements" pages are not placement lists: they give degree years (recorded as graduation) and current positions at the time of the snapshot, flagged in note as not first placements; Karel Cool, Jack Hughes and Beck A. Taylor lack a year in some or all snapshots. (6) Abel Jeuland page is a single-person distinguished-alumnus profile with no year or program.
